title: Agile capstone with an LLM-enabled web application
summary: Senior computer science students work in teams of six to propose and build a semester-long web application using Agile roles and professional tools. During requirements and implementation they identify an appropriate LLM-enabled feature and integrate it through the ChatGPT API.

sources.title: WIP: Enhancing Career Preparedness Through a Software Engineering Capstone Course Design
sources.evidence_quote: During the implementation phase, they gain hands-on experience by implementing these features into their applications, utilizing ChatGPT APIs to embed advanced functionalities.

assessment.summary: Propose, design, implement, test, and present a team web application using Agile practices, professional tools, and an appropriate LLM-enabled feature.
student_actions: Propose a meaningful project theme and gather requirements.
Produce requirements, UX, architecture, implementation, and testing deliverables.
Investigate an LLM-supported feature such as personalization, recommendation, or generated content.
Integrate the feature using the ChatGPT API.
Document the project for use in a professional resume.

student_role.description: Students are trained to identify and implement an LLM-enabled feature within their application.

grading.method: The paper reports milestone deliverables but not the assessment rubric or grade weights.

reported_results: Concern, curiosity, and confidence measures increased significantly; control did not show a significant improvement.
